resources.string: %1$s from My data: %2$s, tap inserts it
Own e-mail, number or IBAN as a chip in matching fields

The strip offers what fits the field (e-mail, code, phone, IBAN) and after words like “look, this video” or “my number is”: a fresh clip or your own entry. A tap inserts it. Local, never in password fields, incognito or while the device is locked.
Context learning: while learning is on (Typing → Learned words), the keyboard notes which suggestions you tap or pass by, only as small numbers without any text. “Delete learned words” removes them.
Optional and empty at first. Stored encrypted on this device only, never in backups. Never put passwords here; a password manager is the right place for them.
Unlock the device to see or change My data.
IBAN %d does not look valid; it is saved as typed.
Delete all of My data from this device?
My data could not be read or saved.
